title: Tomorrow's World: Nellie the School Computer 15 February 1969 - BBC
summary: A 1969 BBC Tomorrow's World segment about Nellie, a school computer used by pupils at Forest Grammar School to solve equations and play music. Students learn programming and maintenance, and act out binary arithmetic.
why: Shared as a charming historical look at children learning computing, including kids acting as register bits.

quote.text: Kids acting as bits in a machine register and performing binary arithmetic by raising their hands if set, or not raising when cleared.
